links.comparator_used: Human annotation: three human annotators adjudicated discrepant cases, and LLM-extracted labels were compared with the final human labels and with interrater agreement
links.outcome: Agreement of LLM-extracted ground truth labels with final human annotations in discrepant cases, versus agreement between human readers
links.effect: LLM vs final human annotation κ = 0.731; interreader agreement κ = 0.720. No statistically significant performance differences between PCCT and non-PCCT cohorts when using LLM labels.
links.tradeoff: LLM labeling errors still occurred. Discrepant cases needed human adjudication, and performance metrics were recalculated after partial human correction of LLM errors.
links.quote: In discrepant cases, the agreement between LLM labels and final human annotations (κ = 0.731) was comparable with interreader agreement (κ = 0.720), supporting the reliability of LLM labeling.

design_hint: local validation after hardware change using LLM-extracted ground truth
